prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Daggerfall Unity NPC pixel-art upper-eye gaze atlas
Primary request: Edit the supplied exact 3x3 reference grid of this same woman into nine clearly distinct, natural gaze directions. Keep her warm, visibly happy expression and her own happy brows in every cell. Return only one 3x3 atlas of complete upper-face cells, all with identical framing.
Input image: Image 1 is the sole reference. It is the exact inspected 3x3 grid made from this portrait own happy open-eye source. Do not use any other image.
Direction order, row-major: top-left=up-left, top-center=up, top-right=up-right; middle-left=left, middle-center=center, middle-right=right; bottom-left=down-left, bottom-center=down, bottom-right=down-right. Both eyes must aim together in every cell. Each diagonal must visibly combine horizontal and vertical gaze. Make all nine directions distinct; do not repeat a horizontal direction in the upper or lower rows.
Eye anatomy: Draw each iris, pupil, upper lid and lower lid as one coherent eye in both eyes. Keep a continuous, closed-contour upper and lower eyelid line following each eyeball; preserve both inner and outer eye corners. Keep the compact iris and pupil fully inside the eye opening. Looking up naturally raises the upper lids enough to open the eyes modestly and leave real space for the elevated irises. Do not push a pupil through a fixed narrow slit or place it on top of a lid. This is a gentle upward look, not a startled or enlarged-eye expression. Looking down lowers gaze within naturally lowered upper lids; lids may softly cover the upper iris edge. Keep both eyes anatomically balanced and aligned. Do not move brows or whole sockets to fake gaze.
Iris and highlights: Keep each iris compact, muted violet-gray, organic, and non-rectangular, with a small curved or naturally stepped pixel silhouette. Keep a readable small pupil inside it. Add only a mild, tiny, muted warm glint to each iris, matching the subdued pixel-art palette; no bright white sparkle, broad white crescent, extra shine, or harsh contrast. Preserve original square-pixel structure, coherent scale, and the source eye spacing.
Identity and expression: Preserve this exact face, hair, skin, original warm brown palette, crop, pixel lattice, and happy brow expression. Keep the middle-center gaze straight ahead and visually closest to the supplied center source. Do not neutralize or intensify the happy expression. Keep content outside the eye features unchanged. The atlas cells have no gutters, border, labels, text, watermark, or extra content.
Avoid square iris blocks, purple bars, floating or cut-off pupils, disconnected lid lines, giant irises, huge sclera, eye enlargement, shifted brows, altered hair/background, vector-like curves, and new elements. Match the native 64:35 upper-half aspect in every cell and return one row-major 3x3 atlas.
